issues.body: The parser defaults omitted `planned`, `dispatched`, and `defer_reasons` fields to 0/0/{}, while `quiet` requires only `summary is not None`. Consequently `{}`, `{"planned": 0}`, and even an empty JSON list all become `idle` when the claim outcome is success. That is absence of evidence, not the positive empty-frontier observation described by this change, and the resulting fleet idle record immediately recovers an open zero-dispatch alert. The new test checks `None` and `planned: None`, but misses the omitted-field path created by these defaults.
issues.fix_hint: Require the summary to be a mapping containing schema-valid, non-boolean integer `planned` and `dispatched` fields and a mapping `defer_reasons` field before allowing `quiet`; otherwise emit `none`. Add assertions using literal `{}`, an empty list, omitted `dispatched`/`defer_reasons`, and boolean numeric fields so each malformed/incomplete shape stays `none`.
issues.title: Incomplete summaries fabricate an idle observation

verdict.summary: The new idle observation is not fail-closed at the workflow evidence boundary. A successfully parsed but incomplete summary is promoted to positive empty-frontier evidence and can close an open zero-dispatch alert even though the summary never established that the frontier was empty. The self-test covers a missing summary and an explicit null planned value, but not omitted fields or wrong JSON container shapes, so it does not catch this path.
